subject: Delta window stabilization plan & credit proposal
messages:
From: Jordan Hale <jordan.hale@arcadiahealth.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@arcadiahealth.com
Date: Wed, 15 Aug 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Timing pressure on go-live — request for delta credit and MAP update

Hi Vivek,

Quick note from procurement and program: we ran into a scheduling cascade on our side — two downstream teams (SSO cert and internal security review) pushed their milestones out by ~10 business days. That means our original MAP milestones (acceptance testing week of 8/28) are now unlikely.

We need to understand Redwood's willingness to: 
- shift the MAP acceptance milestones by two weeks, and
- provide a short-term credit or pro-rated discount for the delayed acceptance (we'd push the formal acceptance window to 9/11),

Attached is our internal impact matrix (arcadia_delta_impact_matrix.xlsx) showing the knock-on effects. From procurement perspective, this is a close date drift risk and we'll need a documented MAP change and a formal credit proposal to move forward with signature.

Can you confirm options by EOD Friday? Also looping in procurement so they have the ask on record.

Thanks,
Jordan Hale
Senior Program Manager — Arcadia Health
procurement@arcadiahealth.com

(attachment: arcadia_delta_impact_matrix.xlsx)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Hale <jordan.hale@arcadiahealth.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com, rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com, neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com
Date: Fri, 17 Aug 2028 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Timing pressure on go-live — request for delta credit and MAP update

Jordan — thanks for the heads up and the matrix. I read through the attachment and the knock-on list makes sense.

Short answer: we can accommodate a two-week shift to the MAP milestones and propose a pragmatic mitigation/compensation approach rather than a full credit. Options we can consider:

1) Two-week MAP extension with a 25% pro-rated service credit for the delayed acceptance period (applies to hosted API usage tied to acceptance tests).
2) No upfront credit but a guaranteed 30% priority access to Dedicated pool during your new acceptance window (reduces flakiness risk during canary).
3) Split the difference: 10% credit + Dedicated pool priority for the first week.

Operational asks from our side to finalize:
- a revised MAP doc with new milestone dates and ownership (I can draft and circulate),
- a short evidence packet showing the SSO cert timeline and the security signoff owner (we'll need that to make the credit conditional),
- confirmation of whether the acceptance scope changes (functional tests vs. performance/cost gating).

I'll draft a proposed MAP v2 and a credit breakdown and loop Laura and Rishi for feasibility on Dedicated capacity. If that works, I should be able to get a formal offer and DocuSign-ready addendum by Tues.

Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Customer Success | Redwood Inference

> On Wed, Aug 15, 2028 at 9:12 AM Jordan Hale <jordan.hale@arcadiahealth.com> wrote:
> > Hi Vivek,
> > ... (see above attachment)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwoodinference.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com, rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com, neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 20 Aug 2028 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: Arcadia — delta window stabilization proposal (need numbers + legal language)

Team — quick internal thread to capture feasibility and produce the docs Jordan asked for.

Context: Arcadia's acceptance window will slip ~10 business days. Procurement is asking for a documented MAP change + a credit proposal. Options I floated: 25% pro-rated credit (timeboxed), Dedicated pool priority, or a blended 10% credit + one-week priority. We should surface the unit economics and risk exposure so Sales/Legal can sign off.

Rishi — can you confirm whether we can commit to a one-week Dedicated priority (30% extra qps) during their acceptance window without breaking other commitments? Please include estimated incremental GPU-hours and the fallback if capacity squeeze hits.

Laura — procurement/legal will want a short clause for the addendum: conditional credit if acceptance is delayed AND Arcadia provides the SSO cert date and security owner by the first revised milestone. Draft language: "If Customer provides documented evidence of third-party schedule drift (SSO/infra) and acceptance is pushed beyond the mutually agreed MAP milestone, Supplier will grant a pro-rated service credit equal to X% of invoice line-item Y for the delayed period; credit applies only to services used during the revised acceptance window and is subject to documentation." Thoughts?

Neha — can you run a quick risk ledger: what is our exposure if Arcadia signs the MAP v2 now and then delays again? Also, any precedent for gating credits on evidence we should call out?

I attached my draft MAP v2 and a stub credit_breakdown.csv. Please review by EOD so I can return a single formal offer to Jordan on Tues.

(attachment: proposed_map_v2.pdf)

Thanks — Vivek

From: Jordan Hale <jordan.hale@arcadiahealth.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@arcadiahealth.com, laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
Date: Thu, 30 Aug 2028 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Timing pressure on go-live — request for delta credit and MAP update

Vivek — appreciate the quick turnaround. The MAP v2 you attached (received this morning) looks reasonable and the blended option is our preferred path. Procurement will accept the 10% pro-rated credit + one-week Dedicated priority for the first week of the revised acceptance window, conditional on us providing the SSO certification target and a named security reviewer by 9/4.

We reviewed your draft clause and suggest one small change to clarify the credit calculation (we prefer credits capped to actual acceptance-test usage). If you can update that and send the DocuSign addendum, procurement will route for signature.

Next steps we expect:
- Redwood to update clause language and push DocuSign link by EOD Monday 9/3
- Arcadia to confirm SSO cert owner by 9/4 and final acceptance scope (functional + perf) by 9/6
- Joint canary: schedule a 2-hour canary run in the dedicated pool during revised acceptance week (Redwood to propose windows)

We agree this path stabilizes the delta window and keeps the project moving.

Thanks,
Jordan Hale
Senior Program Manager — Arcadia Health
(attachment: arcadia_delta_impact_matrix.xlsx)
